players.product: Helios trapped-ion quantum computer (Quantum Charge-Coupled Device architecture)

quarterly_data.signal: Quantinuum 8-K: on September 4, 2026 Quantinuum LLC entered an Other Transaction Agreement with the U.S. Department of Commerce (CHIPS R&D Office) finalizing an award of up to $100.0 million - $56.0 million made available on or about the award date and $32.0 million and $12.0 million after project milestones - for R&D at multiple existing U.S. sites on scaling trapped-ion quantum computers: low-loss integrated photonics at 422 nanometers, control ASICs on a high-voltage process for cryogenic operation, and reliable optical components at trapped-ion wavelengths; the period of performance runs to the earlier of milestone completion and five years. In return the Department of Commerce received shares of Quantinuum's Class A common stock. Quantinuum says it was the only company with a trapped-ion architecture awarded CHIPS R&D funding.
quarterly_data.figure: award up to $100.0 million ($56.0 million at award; $32.0 million and $12.0 million on milestones)
